name: layerFwd
stmt: def layerFwd (ls : Layer) (x : List Int) : List Int
proof: ls.map (fun l => LayerOut l x)

name: layerSeq
stmt:
def layerSeq : List Layer → List Int → List Int
  | [], x => x
  | l :: rest, x => layerSeq rest (layerFwd l x)

name: dot_replicate_zero
stmt:
lemma dot_replicate_zero (w : List Int) :
    dot w (List.replicate w.length 0) = 0
proof:
by
  unfold dot
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [List.foldl, List.zip, List.replicate]
  | cons h t ih =>
      simpa [List.foldl, List.zip, List.replicate] using ih

name: dot_replicate_zero_any
stmt:
lemma dot_replicate_zero_any (w : List Int) (n : Nat) :
    dot w (List.replicate n 0) = 0
proof:
by
  unfold dot
  induction w generalizing n with
  | nil => simp [List.foldl, List.zip, List.replicate]
  | cons h t ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp [List.foldl, List.zip, List.replicate]
      | succ m =>
                                                                      
          simpa [List.foldl, List.zip, List.replicate] using ih m

name: layerOut_zero_input
stmt:
lemma layerOut_zero_input (l : LinearLayer) :
    LayerOut l (List.replicate l.w.length 0) = l.b
proof:
by
  unfold LayerOut
  rw [dot_replicate_zero l.w]
  omega

name: layerFwd_allzero
stmt:
theorem layerFwd_allzero (ls : Layer) (x : List Int) :
    AllZeroOutputs ls x ↔ layerFwd ls x = List.replicate ls.length 0
proof:
by
  unfold AllZeroOutputs layerFwd
  constructor
  · intro h
                                                                   
    have hmem : ∀ b ∈ ls.map (fun l => LayerOut l x), b = 0 := by
      intro b hb
      rcases List.mem_map.mp hb with ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
      exact h l hl
    simpa [List.length_map] using (List.eq_replicate_length (a := 0)).mpr hmem
  · intro h
                                                 
    intro l hl
    have hmem : LayerOut l x ∈ ls.map (fun l => LayerOut l x) :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
    have hall : ∀ b ∈ ls.map (fun l => LayerOut l x), b = 0 :=
      (List.eq_replicate_length (a := 0)).mp (by simpa [List.length_map] using h)
    exact hall (LayerOut l x) hmem

name: constraint_satisfaction_propagates
stmt:
theorem constraint_satisfaction_propagates (cs : ConstraintSet) (x : List Int)
    (l2 : LinearLayer) (h : AllSatisfied cs x) :
    LayerOut l2 (layerFwd (compileToLayer cs) x) = l2.b
proof:
by
                               
  have hzero_out : layerFwd (compileToLayer cs) x = List.replicate (compileToLayer cs).length 0 := by
    exact (layerFwd_allzero (compileToLayer cs) x).mp ((symbolToWeight_correct cs x).mp h)
                                       
  rw [hzero_out]
  unfold LayerOut
  rw [dot_replicate_zero_any l2.w (compileToLayer cs).length]
  omega

name: layerSeq_three
stmt:
theorem layerSeq_three (l1 l2 l3 : Layer) (x : List Int) :
    layerSeq [l1, l2, l3] x = layerFwd l3 (layerFwd l2 (layerFwd l1 x))
proof:
by
  simp [layerSeq, layerFwd]

end Lattice

name: IntLayer
doc:
**整数层**：权重矩阵与偏置向量都是 `ℤ`。

真实部署把权重量化到定点网格；「丢低位」的诚实抽象就是整数带余除法，
而 `RoundingBackend.roundingLossy` 已经在一维上证明了它。
stmt: abbrev IntLayer (m n : ℕ)
proof: (Fin m → Fin n → ℤ) × (Fin n → ℤ)

name: quant
doc: **量化**：每个分量除以 2（丢最低位）。
stmt: def quant : IntLayer m n → IntLayer m n
proof: fun L => (fun i j => L.1 i j / 2, fun j => L.2 j / 2)

name: dequant
stmt: def dequant : IntLayer m n → IntLayer m n
proof: fun L => (fun i j => 2 * L.1 i j, fun j => 2 * L.2 j)

name: obsEntrywise
doc:
**观察口径**：每个分量误差 ≤ 1。

**逐分量而非范数**：范数界会把一个坏分量藏在一堆好分量后面，而量化器的失效模式
恰恰是**某一个**分量饱和或舍入错。
stmt: def obsEntrywise (p q : IntLayer m n) : Prop

name: obsEntrywise_refl
doc: 该口径自反（`LossyRep.obs_refl` 要求的）。
stmt: theorem obsEntrywise_refl (p : IntLayer m n) : obsEntrywise p p
proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j; simp
  · intro j; simp

name: dequant_quant_error
doc:
**每个分量的误差不超过 1**——**直接复用一维的 `roundtrip_error_le_one`**，不重新证一遍。

这是「定理级复用」的实质：整层量化的正确性没有独立内容，它就是一维结果在每个分量上成立。
stmt: theorem dequant_quant_error (L : IntLayer m n) : obsEntrywise (dequant (quant L)) L
proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    exact Lattice.Lift.RoundingBackend.roundtrip_error_le_one (L.1 i j)
  · intro j
    exact Lattice.Lift.RoundingBackend.roundtrip_error_le_one (L.2 j)

name: layerQuantization
doc:
**整层量化的 `LossyRep` 实例**：编译是 `quant`，提取是 `dequant`，口径是逐分量误差 ≤ 1。

`semEq` 就是 `dequant_quant_error`——**没有新证明**。
stmt:
noncomputable def layerQuantization : LossyRep (IntLayer m n) (IntLayer m n) where
  inputP
proof:
Fin n → ℤ
  inputW := Fin n → ℤ
  encode := id
  decode := id
  compile := quant
  extract := dequant
  obs := obsEntrywise
  obs_refl := obsEntrywise_refl
  semEq := dequant_quant_error

name: layerQuantization_roundtrip
doc: **这个实例的往返义务是逐分量成立的**：展开形式，供引用。
stmt:
theorem layerQuantization_roundtrip (L : IntLayer m n) :
    obsEntrywise (dequant (quant L)) L
proof: layerQuantization.semEq L

name: layerQuantization_nontrivial
doc:
**它真的丢信息**：存在两个不同的层在观测口径下等价。

取同一层的所有分量都在 `0` 与 `1` 之间的对比——两个相邻整数除以 2 后相同，
乘回 2 后也相同，所以**提取无法区分它们**。这就是「有损」的见证。
stmt:
theorem layerQuantization_nontrivial :
    ∃ p q : IntLayer 1 1, p ≠ q ∧ obsEntrywise (dequant (quant p)) (dequant (quant q))
proof:
by
  refine ⟨(fun _ _ => 0, fun _ => 0), (fun _ _ => 1, fun _ => 1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have h1 := congrArg (fun L : IntLayer 1 1 => L.1 0 0) h
    simp at h1
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j
      show |2 * ((fun _ _ => 0 : Fin 1 → Fin 1 → ℤ) i j / 2) -
            2 * ((fun _ _ => 1 : Fin 1 → Fin 1 → ℤ) i j / 2)| ≤ 1
      simp
    · intro j
      show |2 * ((fun _ => (0 : ℤ)) j / 2) - 2 * ((fun _ => (1 : ℤ)) j / 2)| ≤ 1
      simp

name: layerQuantization_refines_scalar
doc:
**`m = n = 1` 时与标量版一致**：本节的 `quant` 在单分量上就是 `RoundingBackend.compileZ`。

这是「提升而非重写」的机器检查形式。
stmt:
theorem layerQuantization_refines_scalar (x : ℤ) :
    (quant (m := 1) (n := 1) (fun _ _ => x, fun _ => x)).1 0 0 =
      Lattice.Lift.RoundingBackend.compileZ x
proof:
rfl

end Lattice.Lift.IntQuant

name: quant_error_lt_two_pow
doc:
**`b` 位量化的误差严格小于 `2^b`。**

差值正好是余数（`Int.emod_def`），余数落在 `[0, 2^b)`。
stmt:
theorem quant_error_lt_two_pow (b : ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    |2 ^ b * (x / (2 : ℤ) ^ b) - x| < (2 : ℤ) ^ b
proof:
by
  have hpos : (0 : ℤ) < 2 ^ b := by positivity
  have hkey : 2 ^ b * (x / (2 : ℤ) ^ b) - x = -(x % (2 : ℤ) ^ b) := by
    have := Int.emod_def x ((2 : ℤ) ^ b)
    rw [this]; ring
  rw [hkey, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ (ne_of_gt hpos))]
  exact Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hpos

name: quantB
stmt: def quantB (b : ℕ) : IntLayer m n → IntLayer m n
proof: fun L => (fun i j => L.1 i j / (2 : ℤ) ^ b, fun j => L.2 j / (2 : ℤ) ^ b)

name: dequantB
stmt: def dequantB (b : ℕ) : IntLayer m n → IntLayer m n
proof: fun L => (fun i j => 2 ^ b * L.1 i j, fun j => 2 ^ b * L.2 j)

name: obsWithin
doc:
**观察口径**：每个分量误差 `< 2^b`。

用严格小于而不是 `≤`，因为 `b` 位余数的上界是开区间——这与 `b = 0`（不丢位则不失真）
的边界行为一致。
stmt: def obsWithin (b : ℕ) (p q : IntLayer m n) : Prop

name: obsWithin_refl
stmt: theorem obsWithin_refl (b : ℕ) (p : IntLayer m n) : obsWithin b p p
proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    show |p.1 i j - p.1 i j| < (2 : ℤ) ^ b
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; positivity
  · intro j
    show |p.2 j - p.2 j| < (2 : ℤ) ^ b
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; positivity

name: dequantB_quantB_error
doc: **整层的逐分量误差**：每个分量都由一维引理给出。
stmt:
theorem dequantB_quantB_error (b : ℕ) (L : IntLayer m n) :
    obsWithin b (dequantB b (quantB b L)) L
proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    exact quant_error_lt_two_pow b (L.1 i j)
  · intro j
    exact quant_error_lt_two_pow b (L.2 j)

name: layerQuantizationB
doc:
**`b` 位整层量化是一个 `LossyRep`**：位宽是参数，不是硬编码。

`semEq` 就是 `dequantB_quantB_error`——三次复用同一维引理。
stmt:
noncomputable def layerQuantizationB (b : ℕ) : LossyRep (IntLayer m n) (IntLayer m n) where
  inputP
proof:
Fin n → ℤ
  inputW := Fin n → ℤ
  encode := id
  decode := id
  compile := quantB b
  extract := dequantB b
  obs := obsWithin b
  obs_refl := obsWithin_refl b
  semEq := dequantB_quantB_error b

name: layerQuantizationB_one_bits
doc:
**`b = 1` 时与第 183 轮的实现一致**：`quantB 1` 与 `quant` 逐分量相同。

这是「推广而非替换」的机器检查形式。
stmt:
theorem layerQuantizationB_one_bits (L : IntLayer m n) :
    (quantB (m := m) (n := n) 1 L) = quant L
proof:
by
  unfold quantB quant
  simp

end Lattice.Lift.IntQuant
